categories.main_business_segments: China Youran Dairy Group Limited operates primarily in the upstream dairy industry chain, including raw milk production, comprehensive ruminant farming solutions (feeds, forage grass, and farming support services), ruminant farming products marketplace, and breeding business. The Group produces premium and specialty raw milk, concentrated feed products, and breeding products such as frozen semen and sex-sorted embryos.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced breeding technologies including embryo transfer, sex-sorted frozen semen and embryos, and genetic evaluation using the 'Breeding No. 1 Chip'. It utilizes precision nutrition systems, TMR precision feeding, AI-powered environmental controls, and intelligent farm management systems integrating IoT and robotics. Feed production incorporates automated packing and micro-dosing systems, and the Group develops low-carbon and carbon-reducing feed formulations. Forage grass production uses cold-resistant gene technology and wrapped silage processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group's primary customers are large-scale dairy manufacturers such as Yili Group, Bright Dairy, and Junlebao Dairy, as well as dairy farms across China. It serves the dairy industry by supplying raw milk, feed, breeding products, and farming supplies. The Group's marketplace business also caters to dairy farms with over 10,000 types of ruminant farming products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates 97 dairy farms, 15 feed mills, and 16 forage grass plantation bases across 17 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in Mainland China, including Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, and others. It also has breeding bases in the United States (Wisconsin) and China (Horinger and Qingshuihe). Its online platform and offline stores cover 25 provinces in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Youran Dairy Group Limited operates primarily upstream in the dairy supply chain, covering breeding, feed production, forage grass cultivation, and raw milk production. It also extends midstream by providing comprehensive ruminant farming solutions and downstream through its ruminant farming products marketplace.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group focuses on innovation, quality, digitalization, and green transformation. R&D priorities include genetic improvement, sex-sorted embryo technology, low-carbon feed development, precision nutrition, and intelligent farm management. It invests heavily in technology commercialization, digital tools, and sustainable practices such as carbon reduction and photovoltaic energy. The Group aims to lead China's dairy industry through technological breakthroughs and lean management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of raw milk, concentrated feeds, ruminant farming products, and breeding products. The Group also earns revenue via its online platform and offline stores providing farming supplies. Sales are recognized at the point of delivery, with credit terms varying by product and customer.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is a leading player in China's upstream dairy market, holding a leading position in all business segments. It competes with other large dairy producers and feed suppliers in China. Its technological advancements, scale, and comprehensive industry chain integration provide competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB 20.1 billion, a 7.5% increase year-on-year, with gross profit rising 29.4%. The Group operates 97 dairy farms with over 620,000 dairy cows and nearly 20,000 dairy goats. Despite a net loss, the loss narrowed by 40.7% compared to the previous year. Cash EBITDA increased by 38.3% to RMB 5.3 billion, reflecting improved operational efficiency and scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality, premium, and specialty raw milk products with a diversified product matrix including goat milk, organic, A2, DHA, and selenium-rich milk. It leverages advanced breeding and feed technologies to improve milk yield and quality, reduce costs, and promote sustainable, low-carbon farming. Its integrated online and offline platforms provide comprehensive one-stop solutions, enhancing customer convenience and operational efficiency.
